newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Malayan Credit expects better '96 results.
newsitem.headline: Malayan Credit expects better '96 results.

text.p: Property developer Malayan Credit Ltd said on Tuesday that it expects better results for full year 1996 than in 1995.

In an announcement of results for the six months to June 30, which showed net profit rising 88 percent to Singapore $31.18 million, Malayan Credit said the second half would see further development profits recognised from projects that had already been sold.
It said those would be substantially lower than development profits recognised in the first half, but added that earnings from the group's investment properties are expected to remain stable.
"Barring unforeseen circumstances, the results for the full year are expected to be better than those for 1995," the statement said.
Malayan Credit is a unit of car retailer Cycle & Carriage Ltd.
